verdict.rationale: Entrust Identity Verification is an identity-verification/KYC platform (document checks, facial similarity, watchlist screening) invoked on-demand per applicant via API/SDK/webhooks, not an automation or scheduling tool. Recurring job/workflow scheduling is outside its product category — the evidence describes verification workflows (document capture, biometric checks) not cron-like recurring task execution, so this is a category mismatch rather than a missing feature.
